newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs dlr and basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended the afternoon session unchanged both from its midday level against the dollar and against the currency basket, ending at 180.65/70 to one dollar.
The unit opened the day at 186.95/181.00.
Dealers said trade was light with the forint sticking close to the resistance level of the central bank's intervention band and simply following the dollar/mark cross.
(NBH floating intervention range: 4.5 percent wide. NBH currency basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark.)
